items.name: Think In Fink Fall 2022
items.information:
COVID-19 SAFETY INFORMATION:
To prevent overcrowding in the venue, we are limiting each competitor to one guest only.

Masks are strongly recommended.

Competitors should not attend the competition if experiencing symptoms of COVID-19, or if they were exposed to someone with COVID-19.

When not competing, competitors and spectators should attempt to socially distance whenever possible by keeping 3 feet away from others. We also encourage you not to share puzzles with other competitors.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This competition is supported by CubingUSA.
![](https://cubingusa.org/static/img/cubingUSA_4.svg)
